Resume sustained research in `papers/master` in the smooth-poincare-4d checkout. Use `gpt-6.2-astra` at ultra effort as lead. Read `AGENTS.md`, the root README, `INVESTIGATION_SETUP_WORKFLOW.md`, `GPT_RESEARCH_MODEL_WORKFLOW.md`, `REFERENCE_WORKFLOW.md`, and `papers/master/continuation-notes/AFTER_RECOGNITION_ENDPOINT_20261125.md`. Read the master overview, plan, sole register, current TeX, E51 and E52 receipts, and the working drafts and registers of the branches you pursue. Recompute working revisions and reconcile returns with the ownership crosswalk. If using a concurrent formalization result, check its actual public declaration, hypotheses and acceptance receipt.

Direct recognition includes equality for an actual positive class at $4\pi^2$ or a hypersurface-induced class at $64\pi^2/9$. An infimum-only argument for a positive class needs $I^+(M)<4\pi^2$. Keep positive entry below $8\pi^2$ on arbitrary smooth types as a separate objective. A finite joint cap budget may equal $8\pi^2$ once positivity is established for every cap. The joined positivity path requires a strict bound.

You have broad authority to change proof order, try alternative constructions, consult primary sources, reopen or create B/E tasks, and create `gpt-6.2-sol` helpers at ultra effort. Continue through useful alternatives without routine approval. In parallel, seek a whole marked shell on one physical minimizing sequence and a qualifying retained exterior. Follow the evidence into diffuse repair, the actual attaching maps of a selected height, endpoint attainment, closed rigidity or restart termination. Keep each sign, energy, gauge, marking and smooth type attached to the object that supplies it. Compare the smooth types and alternatives still open after each result.

Coordinate with existing writers. Freeze each helper's task ID, input versions, finite target, distinct output and acceptance test. Have a different reader check the decisive step. Develop intermediate results in the owning branch draft and preserve scoped failures there or in its research records. Promote a checked implication when it discharges a named master hypothesis, settles a remaining case or shortens the proof under the same or weaker assumptions. Update the owning register and rebuild each changed manuscript PDF. At the next substantial milestone, report the strongest verified implication with its quantifiers, the premise actually removed and the first obstruction that survives.

I’ll check the current manuscripts, receipts, and writer assignments first. Then I’ll pursue the marked-shell and retained-exterior questions in parallel and have a separate reader check any implication that could shorten the master proof.

The endpoint now gives more information about the minimizing sequence. If \(I^+(M)=4\pi^2\) on a nonstandard type, the physical Yamabe metrics must have trace-free Ricci curvature tending to zero in \(L^2\). The same estimate constrains where the two Weyl chiralities can carry energy. I’m checking whether that locates the missing charge on actual standard disks.

At \(I^+(M)=4\pi^2\), the disk-selection argument now captures both chiral energies up to any prescribed error. An independent reader checked the transfer back to the original minimizing sequence. The remaining estimate concerns the collars of those same disks: their small physical curvature integrals do not yet control the cost of splicing them.

**At the unattained endpoint \(I^+(M)=4\pi^2\), the master proof now locates both chiral energies on standard disks.** For every volume-one positive Yamabe minimizing sequence on the fixed smooth type, there is a subsequence such that, for every \(\varepsilon,\zeta>0\), finitely many disjoint parametrized smooth four-disks leave less than \(\varepsilon\) of the **combined** chiral energy outside them. Each disk lies in a comparison ball carrying less than \(\zeta\) of the original physical full-curvature integral. Theorem 6.4 gives the precise quantifiers. [Master manuscript, p. 14](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/output/pdf/master/chiral_weyl_energy_and_smooth_poincare.pdf)

**The premise removed is the separate estimate on energy outside the selected disks.** The proof uses Chen–Zhu’s modified Yamabe representative. At the endpoint, its normalized volume approaches the combined chiral measure divided by \(8\pi^2\) in total variation. This transfers disk selection back to the original sequence. The physical Yamabe metrics also satisfy \(\int|\mathrm{Ric}_0|^2<8(E_+-4\pi^2)\). genui{"citation":{"refs":["turn163111932view0","turn715794864view0"]}} [Full descent proof, Theorem 3.1](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/output/pdf/master/01_fixed_type_variational_descent/fixed_type_chiral_energy_descent.pdf)

**The first surviving obstruction is the cost of the collars on those same disks.** As the uncovered charge and raw collar charge tend to zero, a uniform saving below \(2\pi\) in the aggregate \(L^2\) splice error would keep the joined path strictly below \(8\pi^2\) and produce a positive metric on \(M\) below \(4\pi^2\). The small curvature integral on each containing ball has yet to give that first-order estimate.

The parallel work produced a conditional whole-shell criterion, explicit qualifying retained exteriors on standard \(S^4\), and additional recognition tests for actual two-middle-handle diagrams. Positive entry on arbitrary smooth types and the alternatives at \(4\pi^2<I^+(M)<8\pi^2\) remain open. [Assessment and remaining cases](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/papers/master/research-progress/handoffs/E53_E55_ENDPOINT_CHARGE_20261125.md) · [Continuation](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/papers/master/continuation-notes/AFTER_ENDPOINT_CHARGE_20261125.md)

All five changed PDFs were rebuilt and independently rendered. The research links passed. The repository-wide check found 16 links to a pending concurrent formalization handoff. An authenticated chat transcript was unavailable.

Resume sustained research in papers/master. Read AGENTS.md, the project workflows, this note, the E53–E55 assessment, the owning registers and current manuscripts. Recompute the input generations. Use GPT-6.2 Astra at ultra effort as lead and bounded GPT-6.2 Sol/ultra helpers with disjoint, frozen tasks and independent checks. At the recognition endpoint seek first-order control on actual selected disk collars or another strict repair. In parallel seek a proper physical marked shell or a qualifying retained exterior on a further smooth type. Keep the finite inclusive recognition and cap bounds, strict joined positivity bound, all physical masses, conformal gauges and smooth markings explicit. Above the endpoint pursue the full residual, closed or restart alternatives. Promote an implication only when it advances a named proof step. Update the owning drafts and registers, rebuild changed PDFs and finish at an assessed milestone.

I’ll verify the current manuscripts and receipts, then test whether the endpoint disk selection gives enough control to build a strict repair. I’ll pursue the physical shell and retained exterior in parallel, with an independent check before promoting any result to the master proof.

The modified Yamabe metrics give a second way to test the recognition endpoint. Along a hypothetical sequence approaching \(4\pi^2\) on nonstandard spheres, the \(L^2\) mass of curvature above a fixed threshold tends to zero. I’m checking whether that estimate gives a common positive Ricci-flow time and a smooth limit. That would settle the endpoint without constructing disk collars.

Two readers checked the Ricci-flow argument through the positive-time limit. It excludes nonstandard smooth types uniformly in a neighborhood of \(4\pi^2\), so the old infimum endpoint no longer requires an attainment hypothesis. A separate check also gives a bound on the chiral energy left outside selected disks above that neighborhood. I’m integrating both proofs and their different ranges into the manuscripts.

**The recognition endpoint is closed.** Theorem 2.3 of the master manuscript proves that there is a universal \(\varepsilon_*>0\) such that, for every closed smooth homotopy four-sphere \(M\),
\[
I^+(M)\le 4\pi^2+\varepsilon_*
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
M\cong_{\mathrm{diff}}S^4.
\]
In particular, an infimum bound \(I^+(M)\le4\pi^2\) now suffices without an attainment hypothesis. The proof gives no numerical value for \(\varepsilon_*\). [Master manuscript, Theorem 2.3](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/output/pdf/master/chiral_weyl_energy_and_smooth_poincare.pdf)

The decisive step works even if the hypothetical nonstandard smooth types vary. For positive classes approaching \(4\pi^2\), the modified Yamabe representatives have vanishing \(L^2\) curvature above a fixed threshold. This gives a common positive Ricci-flow time. At that time a subsequence converges smoothly to a closed positive Einstein metric, diffeomorphic to each late source, with chiral energy **exactly** \(4\pi^2\). The inclusive Chang–Gursky–Yang classification then recognizes the smooth type. Separate readers checked the smoothing estimate and the passage from the limit to global diffeomorphisms. genui{"citation":{"ref":"turn993267590search38"}} [Smoothing review](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/papers/master/01_fixed_type_variational_descent/reviews/E57_CRITICAL_SMOOTHING.md) · [Rigidity review](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/papers/master/01_fixed_type_variational_descent/reviews/E57_RIGIDITY.md)

**Above the gap**, write \(T=4\pi^2\). If \(I^+(M)<4T/3\), every physical minimizing sequence has a subsequence on which, for each fixed tolerance \(\epsilon>0\), finitely many marked standard disks with union \(U_i\) satisfy
\[
E_\pm(g_i;M\setminus U_i)\le 4(e_i-T)+\epsilon
\]
for both signs on the same source. Below \(5T/4\), both raw residuals are strictly below \(T\). **The first surviving obstruction is geometric:** produce a collar on an actually charged disk whose measured repair cost is smaller than the discarded charge minus the minimizing excess. The parallel shell argument still needs a proper physical comparison and saturation of two shell volumes. The exterior investigation ruled out long conformally product Mazur seams and left construction on a further smooth type open. [Descent manuscript](sandbox:/Users/ebbaker/Documents/smooth-poincare-4d/output/pdf/master/01_fixed_type_variational_descent/fixed_type_chiral_energy_descent.pdf)

Positive entry below \(8\pi^2\) on arbitrary smooth types remains open. Already-positive caps may meet the inclusive \(8\pi^2\) joint budget. The joined path used to establish positivity still requires a strict bound.

All four changed PDFs were rebuilt and independently checked. The result has manuscript-level review. An authenticated chat transcript was unavailable.
